title: Connecting to MCP server endpoints
summary: Connect Copilot to Microsoft SQL Server and Fabric lakehouse MCP servers for grounded, tool-using AI.

items: Connect to MCP server endpoints for SQL Server and Fabric lakehouse.
Explain how MCP grounds the assistant in live database context.

blocks.body: MCP server endpoints let an AI assistant query and act on your SQL Server or Fabric lakehouse safely and with live context.

terms.definition: A server exposing tools/resources to AI clients over the Model Context Protocol.
A Fabric analytics store combining a data lake and warehouse experience.

blocks.body: Connect Copilot to an **MCP server endpoint** for **Microsoft SQL Server** or a **Fabric lakehouse**. The assistant can then discover schema and run scoped tools instead of guessing. Secure these endpoints (see Domain 2) with Managed Identity and least privilege.
MCP endpoints are a new attack surface: authenticate with Managed Identity, scope permissions tightly, and log tool invocations.

tips: Know that SQL Server and Fabric lakehouse MCP endpoints are explicitly named in the blueprint.
Securing MCP endpoints is tested in Domain 2 (l0505).

blocks.body: MCP endpoints ground AI assistants in live SQL/Fabric context; connect them securely with Managed Identity.
